text: We have inherited a large house, a great 'world house' in which we have to live together, black and white, Easterner and Westerner, Gentile and Jew, Catholic and Protestant, Moslem and Hindu, a family unduly separated in ideas, culture and interest, who, because we can never again live apart, must learn somehow to live with each other in peace.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.
reference: Where Do We Go from Here: Chaos or Community?
